hook: Forget vague New Year's resolutions. Here are 30 simple money rules to live by in 2027, in three groups: 10 rules about the numbers (emergency fund, the 15% rule, the rule of 72, the 20/4/10 car rule, your FI number), 10 rules about psychology (pay yourself first, the 48-hour rule, why scams cost Americans over $12 billion in 2024), and 10 action rules to protect and grow your money.
shorts: 30 money rules to live by in 2027
10 money mindset rules that change everything
What one year of following money rules can do
